# Mhairi's Song

*Cormac is hurt that his old pupil Mhairi has not asked him for a verse of her race song. Ask her, lightly, how it goes, and bring him 15 Fox Sinews for a set of old camp fiddle strings.*

|---|---|

1. Talk to [Mhairi](../npcs/mhairi_fiddler.md)
